# StrataBench

> Agentic, honest storage benchmarking — HDD, NVMe, AFA, S3 RDMA, VM, and application workloads.

## For AI agents

- Read AGENTS.md for MCP tools, CLI commands, and REST API
- MCP server: `cmd/stratabench-mcp` — tools for plan, validate, run, analyze
- Default to mock mode unless user confirms real hardware targets
- 30+ profiles in `profiles/`; engines: fio, vdbench, SPDK, warp, elbencho, sbk

## Key commands

```
stratabench agent "intent" --target <path> --mock
stratabench plan "intent" --llm
stratabench validate --profile <name> --target <path>
stratabench run --profile <name> --target <path>
```

## LLM env

STRATABENCH_LLM_PROVIDER, STRATABENCH_LLM_URL, STRATABENCH_LLM_API_KEY, STRATABENCH_LLM_MODEL
